blocks.text: must va have to — ikkalasi ham «kerak», lekin kimga kerak?

Qizil kitobda ikkala shaklni ham o'rgangansiz (→ qizil kitob, 31- va 33-darslar): ikkalasi ham majburiyat — «...ishim kerak», «...ishga majburman». Farq — majburiyat **kimdan** keladi. **must** — so'zlovchining o'z fikri, his-tuyg'usi: «men o'zim buni zarur deb bilaman». **have to** — tashqi vaziyat, qoida, boshqa odamning talabi: «shunday qilishga to'g'ri keladi». Britaniya ingliz tilida bu farq sezilarli; Amerika ingliz tilida esa deyarli hamma joyda have to ishlatiladi. Ko'p hollarda ikkalasi ham to'g'ri — tanlov faqat ohangni o'zgartiradi.

headers: have to — tashqi qoida yoki vaziyat
rows: I **must** call Grandma — I miss her.
I **have to** call the bank — they need my signature.
You **must** see this film — it's brilliant!
You **have to** show your passport at the gate.
My doctor says I **have to** get more exercise.

items.text: I **must** finish this book — I want to know how it ends.
items.translation: Bu kitobni **tugatishim kerak** — oxiri nima bilan tugashini bilgim kelyapti.

items.text: I **have to** finish this report — my boss needs it by noon.
items.translation: Bu hisobotni **tugatishim kerak** — boshlig'imga tushgacha kerak.

items.text: All visitors **have to** sign in at reception.
items.translation: Barcha tashrif buyuruvchilar qabulxonada **ro'yxatdan o'tishi kerak**.

blocks.text: must ning shakllari cheklangan — have to esa hamma zamonda

**must** — modal fe'l: faqat hozirgi (va kelajakka qaratilgan) shakli bor. O'tmishda must yo'q — **had to**: «Kecha ishlashga majbur bo'ldim» → I **had to** work yesterday. Kelajak, Present Perfect, modal fe'ldan keyin, infinitiv va -ing shaklida ham faqat **have to** ishlatiladi. So'roq va inkor — do / does / did bilan: **Do** you **have to** ...? Shu bois amalda have to must dan ancha ko'p uchraydi.

items.text: We **had to** wait two hours at the border.
You**'ll have to** book early — the hotel fills up quickly.
items.translation: Erta **band qilishingiz kerak bo'ladi** — mehmonxona tez to'lib qoladi.

items.text: **Do** we **have to** bring our own food?

blocks.text: don't have to va mustn't — butunlay boshqa ma'no

Darak gapda must va have to yaqin bo'lsa, inkorda ular **butunlay boshqa** ma'no beradi. **don't have to** — «shart emas, majburiyat yo'q»: xohlasangiz qiling, xohlamasangiz yo'q. **mustn't** — «mumkin emas, qilma!»: taqiq. O'zbekchada «kerak emas» ikkala ma'noda ham ishlatiladi («Bu yerda chekish kerak emas» — taqiq; «Ertaga kelishing kerak emas» — shart emas), shuning uchun bu juftlik o'zbeklar uchun ayniqsa xavfli. needn't ham «shart emas» ma'nosini beradi (→ 32-dars).

rows: You **don't have to** wear a tie. (xohlasang taq)
You **mustn't** wear jeans to the ceremony. (taqiqlangan)
I **don't have to** go to work tomorrow. (dam olish)
I **mustn't** forget my keys again! (unutmasligim kerak)
Patients **mustn't** eat before the test. (yeyish mumkin emas)

items.text: You **don't have to** pay — the concert is free.
You **mustn't** touch the paintings in the museum.

blocks.text: have got to — og'zaki Britaniya uslubi

**have got to** = have to, lekin og'zaki, norasmiy Britaniya uslubi: I**'ve got to** go — Ketishim kerak. Odatda bir martalik, aniq majburiyat uchun (hozir, bugun, ertaga): I've got to get up early **tomorrow**. Doimiy odat uchun have to tabiiyroq: I **have to** get up early **every day**. O'tgan zamonda had got to deyarli ishlatilmaydi — **had to** kerak. So'roq: **Have** you **got to** ...?, inkor: I **haven't got to** ...

Rasmiy yozma qoidalar, e'lonlar va yo'riqnomalarda ko'pincha **must / must not** ishlatiladi: Passengers **must** wear seat belts. Bu yerda must so'zlovchining fikri emas, rasmiy talab. Kundalik nutqda shu qoida haqida gapirganda — have to: You **have to** wear a seat belt in a taxi here. must ning xulosa ma'nosi («...sa kerak») — 28-darsda.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Yesterday I must work» → I **had to** work; «I will must» → I**'ll have to**; «I must to go» → I **must** go (to yo'q), lekin I **have to** go (to bor); «You mustn't come tomorrow» («kelishing shart emas» demoqchi bo'lib) → You **don't have to** come; «Do I must...?» → **Must** I ...? yoki **Do** I **have to** ...?; «He have to» → he **has to**.

O'zingizdan so'rang: «Bu majburiyatni men o'zim his qilyapmanmi yoki qoida, boshqa odam talab qilyaptimi?» O'zim → must, tashqaridan → have to. Inkorda o'zbekcha «shart emas» → **don't have to**; «mumkin emas», «-ma!» → **mustn't**.

examples.title: **must**: the speaker's own feeling
examples.description: Majburiyatni so'zlovchining o'zi his qiladi: zarur deb biladi, tavsiya qiladi, o'ziga eslatadi. O'zbekcha «...ishim kerak», «albatta ...».

sentences.text: I **must** call my grandmother tonight; I haven't spoken to her for weeks.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun buvimga **qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak**; bir necha haftadan beri gaplashmadim.

sentences.text: You **must** come and visit us in Samarkand — we'd love to see you.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga, bizning oldimizga **albatta kelinglar** — sizni ko'rishni juda xohlaymiz.

sentences.text: This book is amazing — you really **must** read it.
sentences.translation: Bu kitob ajoyib — uni **albatta o'qishing kerak**.

sentences.text: We **must** do something about the noise from the flat upstairs.
sentences.translation: Yuqori qavatdagi kvartiradan keladigan shovqin bo'yicha biror **chora ko'rishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: I really **must** stop eating so much bread — my jeans don't fit any more.
sentences.translation: Shuncha ko'p non yeyishni **to'xtatishim shart** — jinsi shimim sig'may qoldi.

sentences.text: It's a fantastic exhibition; Madina says everyone **must** see it.
sentences.translation: Bu ajoyib ko'rgazma; Madinaning aytishicha, uni hamma **ko'rishi shart**.

sentences.text: We **must** get together soon — it's been ages since we last met.
sentences.translation: Yaqinda albatta **uchrashishimiz kerak** — oxirgi marta ko'rishganimizga ancha bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Jasur, you **must** be more careful with your money.
sentences.translation: Jasur, pulingga ehtiyotkorroq **bo'lishing kerak**.

sentences.text: I **must** remember to buy a present for Kate's birthday on Friday.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni Keytning tug'ilgan kuniga sovg'a olishni **esdan chiqarmasligim kerak**.

sentences.text: Teachers **must** treat every student fairly, in my opinion.
sentences.translation: Fikrimcha, o'qituvchilar har bir o'quvchiga adolatli **munosabatda bo'lishi shart**.

examples.title: **have to**: rules and outside pressure
examples.description: Majburiyat tashqaridan keladi: qoida, ish, shifokor, jadval. O'zbekcha «...ishim kerak», «...ishga majburman».

sentences.text: In this company everyone **has to** wear an ID badge.
sentences.translation: Bu kompaniyada hamma shaxsiy guvohnoma **taqib yurishi kerak**.

sentences.text: I **have to** get up at five tomorrow, because my flight is at seven.
sentences.translation: Ertaga soat beshda **turishim kerak**, chunki reysim soat yettida.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has to** work two jobs to pay for his studies.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'qishiga pul to'lash uchun ikki joyda **ishlashga majbur**.

sentences.text: In Britain you **have to** drive on the left.
sentences.translation: Britaniyada yo'lning chap tomonidan **haydash kerak**.

sentences.text: My doctor says I **have to** take these tablets three times a day.
sentences.translation: Shifokorimning aytishicha, bu tabletkalarni kuniga uch marta **ichishim kerak**.

sentences.text: Students **have to** hand in their essays by the end of the month.
sentences.translation: Talabalar insholarini oy oxirigacha **topshirishlari kerak**.

sentences.text: **Do** you **have to** wear a helmet when you ride those electric scooters?
sentences.translation: Anavi elektr samokatlarni haydaganda dubulg'a **kiyish kerakmi**?

sentences.text: Sorry, I can't stay — I **have to** pick up my son from school.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qola olmayman — o'g'limni maktabdan **olib ketishim kerak**.

sentences.text: Nilufar **has to** travel to Fergana every week for her job.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ishi tufayli har hafta Farg'onaga **borib turishiga to'g'ri keladi**.

sentences.text: How many hours a day **does** a junior doctor **have to** work?
sentences.translation: Yosh shifokor kuniga necha soat **ishlashi kerak**?

examples.title: **must** or **have to**? Inside or outside
examples.description: Juft-juft: bir xil ish — avval o'z istagim bilan (must), keyin tashqi sabab bilan (have to).

sentences.text: I **must** lose some weight — I feel terrible.
sentences.translation: **Ozishim kerak** — o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman.

sentences.text: The doctor says I **have to** lose weight before the operation.
sentences.translation: Shifokorning aytishicha, operatsiyadan oldin **ozishimga to'g'ri keladi**.

sentences.text: I **must** clean the car this weekend — it's really dirty.
sentences.translation: Shu dam olish kunlari mashinani **yuvishim kerak** — juda iflos.

sentences.text: Dad needs the car for the wedding, so I **have to** clean it today.
sentences.translation: Dadamga mashina to'y uchun kerak, shuning uchun bugun uni **yuvishim kerak**.

sentences.text: We **must** visit Aziz in hospital — he'll be so pleased.
sentences.translation: Azizni kasalxonada **yo'qlashimiz kerak** — u juda xursand bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Visitors **have to** leave the hospital by eight o'clock.
sentences.translation: Tashrif buyuruvchilar kasalxonani soat sakkizgacha **tark etishlari kerak**.

sentences.text: You **must** try the samsa at this place — they're the best in town.
sentences.translation: Bu yerning somsasini **albatta tatib ko'ring** — shahardagi eng zo'ri.

sentences.text: You **have to** pay before you eat in this café; that's the system.
sentences.translation: Bu kafeda ovqatdan oldin **to'lash kerak**; tartib shunday.

sentences.text: Sarah thinks she **must** learn Spanish before her trip to Madrid.
sentences.translation: Sara Madridga safaridan oldin ispan tilini **o'rganishi kerak, deb hisoblaydi**.

sentences.text: Sarah's new job is in Madrid, so she **has to** learn Spanish.
sentences.translation: Saraning yangi ishi Madridda, shuning uchun ispan tilini **o'rganishga majbur**.

examples.title: Past and future: **had to**, **will have to**, **have had to**
examples.description: must ning o'tmish va kelajak shakli yo'q — had to, will have to, have had to, might have to, having to.

sentences.text: The lift was broken, so we **had to** climb twelve floors.
sentences.translation: Lift buzuq edi, shuning uchun o'n ikki qavatga piyoda **chiqishga majbur bo'ldik**.

sentences.text: Tom **had to** cancel his holiday because his father was ill.
sentences.translation: Otasi kasal bo'lgani uchun Tom ta'tilini **bekor qilishga majbur bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: If the train is late again, we**'ll have to** take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Agar poyezd yana kechiksa, taksiga **o'tirishimizga to'g'ri keladi**.

sentences.text: Madina **has had to** rewrite her thesis three times.
sentences.translation: Madina dissertatsiyasini uch marta **qayta yozishga majbur bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: **Did** you **have to** wait long at the passport office?
sentences.translation: Pasport bo'limida uzoq **kutishingizga to'g'ri keldimi**?

sentences.text: Next year all cars **will have to** pass a stricter emissions test.
sentences.translation: Kelasi yildan barcha mashinalar qattiqroq ekologik tekshiruvdan **o'tishi kerak bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: I hate **having to** get up in the dark in winter.
sentences.translation: Qishda qorong'ida **turishga majbur bo'lishni** yomon ko'raman.

sentences.text: Jasur **might have to** sell his car to pay the debt.
sentences.translation: Qarzni to'lash uchun Jasur mashinasini **sotishga majbur bo'lishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: We **didn't have to** pay for the museum, because it was a holiday.
sentences.translation: Muzey uchun **pul to'lashimiz shart bo'lmadi**, chunki bayram kuni edi.

sentences.text: Since the factory closed, many families **have had to** move to the city.
sentences.translation: Zavod yopilgandan beri ko'p oilalar shaharga **ko'chishga majbur bo'ldi**.

examples.title: **don't have to** or **mustn't**?
examples.description: don't have to — «shart emas», ixtiyoriy; mustn't — «mumkin emas», taqiq. O'zbekchadagi «kerak emas» ikkalasiga ham to'g'ri keladi — ehtiyot bo'ling.

sentences.text: You **don't have to** come to the meeting — it's optional.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishga **kelishing shart emas** — ixtiyoriy.

sentences.text: You **mustn't** tell anyone about the surprise party!
sentences.translation: Kutilmagan ziyofat haqida hech kimga **aytma**!

sentences.text: Tomorrow is Sunday, so I **don't have to** set an alarm.
sentences.translation: Ertaga yakshanba, budilnik **qo'yishim shart emas**.

sentences.text: Passengers **mustn't** leave their bags unattended at the airport.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar aeroportda sumkalarini **qarovsiz qoldirmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **doesn't have to** work, but she enjoys her job.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning **ishlashi shart emas**, lekin u ishini yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: We **mustn't** be late for the interview — first impressions matter.
sentences.translation: Suhbatga **kechikmasligimiz kerak** — birinchi taassurot muhim.

sentences.text: We **don't have to** hurry; the film doesn't start until nine.
sentences.translation: **Shoshilishimiz shart emas**; film soat to'qqizda boshlanadi.

sentences.text: You **mustn't** take photos inside the mosque during prayers.
sentences.translation: Namoz vaqtida masjid ichida **surat olish mumkin emas**.

sentences.text: Oliver **doesn't have to** wear a suit — his office is very relaxed.
sentences.translation: Oliverning **kostyum kiyishi shart emas** — ofisi juda erkin.

sentences.text: Children **mustn't** play near the railway line; it's extremely dangerous.
sentences.translation: Bolalar temir yo'l yaqinida **o'ynamasligi kerak**; bu o'ta xavfli.

examples.title: Informal British: **have got to**
examples.description: have got to = have to, og'zaki nutqda, ko'pincha bir martalik aniq majburiyat uchun. So'roq — Have you got to ...?

sentences.text: Sorry, I**'ve got to** go — my bus leaves in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **ketishim kerak** — avtobusim besh daqiqadan keyin jo'naydi.

sentences.text: Aziz **has got to** finish the presentation by tomorrow morning.
sentences.translation: Aziz taqdimotni ertaga ertalabgacha **tugatishi kerak**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **got to** work this weekend, or are you free?
sentences.translation: Bu dam olish kunlari **ishlashing kerakmi** yoki bo'shmisan?

sentences.text: We**'ve got to** buy a present for Mum — her birthday is on Sunday.
sentences.translation: Oyimga sovg'a **olishimiz kerak** — tug'ilgan kuni yakshanba.

sentences.text: You**'ve got to** admit that the new stadium looks impressive.
sentences.translation: **Tan olish kerak**, yangi stadion ta'sirli ko'rinadi.

sentences.text: Kate **hasn't got to** go to the office today; she's working from home.
sentences.translation: Keytning bugun ofisga **borishi shart emas**; u uydan ishlayapti.

sentences.text: I**'ve** really **got to** stop checking my phone during dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat paytida telefonimni tekshirishni rostdan **to'xtatishim kerak**.

sentences.text: What time **have** we **got to** be at the airport?
sentences.translation: Aeroportda soat nechada **bo'lishimiz kerak**?

sentences.text: There's no milk left — someone**'s got to** go to the shop.
sentences.translation: Sut qolmabdi — kimdir do'konga **borishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has got to** pass this exam, or he'll lose his place at university.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bu imtihondan albatta **o'tishi kerak**, aks holda universitetdagi o'rnini yo'qotadi.

examples.title: Dialogue: the first day at a new job
examples.description: Jasur yangi ishining birinchi kunida: nima shart, nima shart emas, nima taqiqlangan — have to, don't have to, mustn't, had to, have got to, must.

sentences.text: — Welcome, Jasur! First, you **have to** sign these forms for HR.
sentences.translation: — Xush kelibsiz, Jasur! Avval kadrlar bo'limi uchun bu hujjatlarni **imzolashingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: — Of course. **Do** I **have to** wear a tie every day?
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Har kuni galstuk **taqishim kerakmi**?

sentences.text: — No, you **don't have to** — only when you meet clients.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **shart emas** — faqat mijozlar bilan uchrashganda.

sentences.text: — Good. And what time **do** I **have to** arrive in the morning?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi. Ertalab soat nechada **kelishim kerak**?

sentences.text: — We start at nine, but you **mustn't** be late on Mondays — there's a team meeting.
sentences.translation: — Soat to'qqizda boshlaymiz, lekin dushanba kunlari **kechikmang** — jamoa yig'ilishi bo'ladi.

sentences.text: — I see. **Will** I **have to** work at weekends sometimes?
sentences.translation: — Tushunarli. Ba'zan dam olish kunlari ham **ishlashimga to'g'ri keladimi**?

sentences.text: — Only before big deadlines. Last month we **had to** work two Saturdays.
sentences.translation: — Faqat katta muddatlardan oldin. O'tgan oy ikki shanba **ishlashga majbur bo'ldik**.

sentences.text: — That's fine. Oh, I**'ve got to** move my car — it's in the director's space!
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Voy, mashinamni **olib qo'yishim kerak** — direktorning joyida turibdi!

sentences.text: — Yes, you really **must** move it before he arrives!
sentences.translation: — Ha, u kelguncha **albatta olib qo'ying**!

sentences.text: — Right away. I **must** make a good impression on my first day.
sentences.translation: — Hoziroq. Birinchi kunimda yaxshi taassurot **qoldirishim kerak**.

examples.title: Mixed: rules, plans and advice
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: must, have to ning barcha shakllari, don't have to, mustn't va have got to murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Drivers **must** stop completely at a red light — it's the law.
sentences.translation: Haydovchilar qizil chiroqda butunlay **to'xtashi shart** — bu qonun.

sentences.text: I **had to** borrow money from my brother when I lost my job.
sentences.translation: Ishimdan ayrilganimda akamdan qarz **olishga majbur bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: You **don't have to** be an expert to enjoy classical music.
sentences.translation: Klassik musiqadan zavqlanish uchun **mutaxassis bo'lish shart emas**.

sentences.text: Employees **must not** share their passwords with anyone.
sentences.translation: Xodimlar parollarini hech kimga **bermasligi shart**.

sentences.text: Once you've got your visa, you**'ll have to** register with the police within a week.
sentences.translation: Viza olganingizdan keyin bir hafta ichida politsiyada **ro'yxatdan o'tishingiz kerak bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: My grandparents **had to** walk five kilometres to school every day.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim har kuni maktabga besh kilometr **piyoda borishga majbur bo'lishgan**.

sentences.text: We**'ve got to** find a cheaper flat, or we'll never save any money.
sentences.translation: Arzonroq kvartira **topishimiz kerak**, aks holda hech qachon pul yig'a olmaymiz.

sentences.text: **Does** Madina **have to** take the entrance exam again next year?
sentences.translation: Madina kirish imtihonini kelasi yil yana **topshirishi kerakmi**?

sentences.text: You really **must** try to relax more — you look exhausted.
sentences.translation: Haqiqatan ham ko'proq **dam olishga harakat qilishingiz kerak** — juda charchagan ko'rinasiz.

sentences.text: Since the new law came in, shops **have had to** charge customers for plastic bags.
sentences.translation: Yangi qonun kuchga kirgandan beri do'konlar xaridorlardan plastik paket uchun **haq olishga majbur bo'lib qoldi**.
